title: LADA Turbo Kings vs Hosers, Nov 8
notes: Away game at Renton: we wore light blue and had the left bench; the Hosers wore white with red and black trim and blue pants. Our goalie was a sub, Pfeifer #1, in red. Renton's camera has been re-aimed since Oct 17, so this game's rink geometry and ice-map calibration were measured on this video. The recording has sound.

Periods, goals and penalties come from the arena scoreboard (LADA TK were GUEST), the game sheet and the video. Goals at 1:58, 4:13 and 20:12 of the video, each checked by eye, matching the sheet's 16:02 and 13:48 of the 1st and 17:28 of the 2nd. Shots on goal from the game sheet: LADA TK 23, Hosers 26 (2-10 in the 3rd).

The video stops at 66:10 with 20 s or more left on the 3rd period's clock and play still going; the board's lights were dark for the last half minute. The 3rd period here ends at the end of the video.

Penalty kills, both Bronnikov #74's: roughing at 8:56 of the 3rd, 2:00 (52:22 to 55:26 of the video; the infraction itself isn't on camera: the referee signals as the Hosers carry in along our bench boards, and Bronnikov comes off the bench to the box); then unsportsmanlike conduct from our bench at 6:47, 8 s after the first ended, 2:00 (55:35 to 59:13). Neither was scored on.
Absent: Kondratenko #12, Babkin #26, Unuchek #49, Olyanich #89 and the goalie Fisenko #58; the sub Kleiman #69 didn't play.

Lineups checked by eye where the solver had the wrong count or a long shift: 22 on/off spans, none labeled by hand. Belousenko #13's 5:07 shift in the 2nd (25:25 to 30:32 of the video) is real: the checker saw him on the ice throughout.

Our net was set at the wrong end of each period when the tracks were built. The ice maps and zone times use the right ends, but the tracker dropped our skaters' detections in the Hosers' crease (1.5-3.8% per period, about 100-180 player-seconds) instead of ours, so time at their net is slightly under-counted in the maps.

highlights.note: 1st period, clock 16:02: Sokolov pokes in the loose puck in a scramble at their crease, their goalie down, 1-0
1st period, clock 13:48: jammed in from the side of a pile-up in our crease, 1-1
2nd period, clock 17:28: tucked in at the post from the goal line, 1-2
3rd period, clock 8:56: roughing, 2 minutes; the infraction itself isn't on camera (the referee signals as they carry in along our bench boards, and Bronnikov comes off the bench to the box)
3rd period, clock 6:47: unsportsmanlike conduct, 2 minutes, from our bench 8 s after the first penalty ended
